title: Cholesterol–systolic-pressure coupling adds no established cross-site CAD prediction beyond additive clinical summaries
abstract: A cholesterol-by-resting-systolic-pressure interaction changed Hungarian Brier loss from 0.147536 to 0.147471 (difference -0.000065; source-refit/target bootstrap95% interval [-0.004129, +0.010721]); incremental benefit was not established. Frozen models trained in Cleveland were evaluated in Hungary. Both historical cohorts were previously used by the author, so this is exploratory independent-site evaluation, not untouched confirmation. The null-compatible result does not establish equivalence or refute joint vascular risk.
